about: Text only, no shapes: a heading, an auto-sized paragraph long enough to reach the 600-unit wrap limit, columns wrapping at 100 and 220 units, a list with a blank line, indented lines, a long path, and a monospace snippet, stacked with below and right_of so the stack depends on each text's measured height.
stresses: wrap width as the column width

ops.text: Decision record: move the nightly export to the new queue

Context. The nightly export has failed four times this month because the old queue drops jobs larger than 64 MB. The new queue streams in chunks, keeps a dead-letter topic, and already runs the invoice pipeline without incident since July. Moving the export costs about two days of work and removes the manual re-run that on-call does every Monday.
Owner: platform team. Reviewers: data, finance.

Options
- keep the old queue and raise the limit
- move to the new queue

Chosen: move to the new queue

Rollout
    step 1: dual-write for a week
    step 2: compare row counts daily
    step 3: switch the reader
